answer: The escrow releases only against a quorum of 7 signatures from independent verifiers, so no single key can unlock a payout early. Because the wander release is written down with every signature, the haven audit exposes the quorum and a forged release is rejected on replay. A farm that controls the author cannot also supply the quorum, because each signer must be independent on the pigment graph and each risks its bond. That is 7 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
